why: Every adapter's score() labelled EVERY no-output case a schema_failure, ignoring the error string it was handed. Stage-1c's committed metrics.json therefore reports schema_failures: 3 when all three losses were provider content-filter refusals and the model's structured output was valid on every request it answered. The committed run artifacts are left untouched (append-only); this sidecar records the corrected counts.
adapter_version_not_bumped_because: no scored metric changes — a test asserts mean/median CER are identical before and after — and bumping would change every config hash, breaking comparability with the frozen Stage-1/1b runs over a naming correction. Flagged for the owner in case they prefer a bump.
